name: neon
description: Applies Finnomena's brand so any employee's vibe-coded apps, UI mockups and artwork follow company branding. Ships neon-create (builds on the Neon base, or in an app already on the Coinbase Design System), neon-redesign (colors and typography through CSS variables), neon-audit (recommends a theming depth for an existing project), neon-review (read-only, evidence-backed UI review) and neon-block (draws Brand Artwork such as ads, posts and covers with the Block engine, through the finno tools).
